name: Cuffed to My Silver Fox Captain
original_name: Cuffed to My Silver Fox Captain
overview: Macy returns home to Briarhill, Montana as a rookie cop and to solve her mother's cold case. She's devastated to learn her cheating ex boyfriend is also a police officer at the same precinct. Upset, Macy drowns her sorrows at a bar and hooks up with Hunter, a silver fox, who turns out to be her boss AND her ex's dad! Their secret fling progresses, threatening both their jobs, but sparks fly as they are partnered together. Hunter helps trains Macy, building her confidence...
